subject: Shared delivery playbook & milestone ledger — proposed sprint calendar
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Lee <caroline.lee@helixai.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@helixai.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Shared delivery playbook & milestone ledger — proposed sprint calendar

Hi Caroline —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attached is a compact "shared delivery playbook" and a milestone ledger that we use to coordinate handoff-to-ops for customers running inference at scale. I sketched a pragmatic sprint calendar below so we can align on owners and launch windows. 

High-level proposal (rough dates shown as business-week windows):
- Week 1 (Jul 26–30): Kickoff + environment provisioning (Helix to confirm network/IP allowlist)
- Week 2 (Aug 2–6): Integration sprint 1 — auth, API keys, and test vectors
- Week 3 (Aug 9–13): Load/latency validation + prefix caching setup
- Week 4 (Aug 16–20): Canary run (2-week canary optional) + monitoring hooks
- Week 6 (Aug 30–Sep 3): Final acceptance window and short stabilization sprint

Requested asks for your team:
1) Confirm the two-week canary preference (we can shorten to 1 week if you prefer)
2) Confirm procurement cadence and DocuSign holder so we can lock start dates
3) Call out any blackout dates in Aug/Sept for Helix ops

Attachments: 20260718_shared_playbook.xlsx (playbook + role RACI), milestone-ledger.csv (milestone rows + ownership column), SOW-draft-Helix-RW-v1.pdf (draft terms)

If that looks reasonable I’ll table owners internally and loop in Neha (CS lead) and Marissa (Implementation PM) for the detailed runbook. Suggest a quick 30-min sync Tue or Wed next week to finalize.

Best,
Rishi
Account Exec | Redwood Inference

From: Caroline Lee <caroline.lee@helixai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@helixai.com>, procurement@helixai.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared delivery playbook & milestone ledger — proposed sprint calendar

Thanks Rishi — this is very helpful. A few quick notes: 

- Helix prefers a 2-week canary for production traffic, but we can consider 1 week for an internal-only traffic test.
- Procurement: we need the final SOW and invoice details before Aug 2 to keep the August cadence. I CC'd procurement so they have sight.
- Blackouts: our engineering org has a freeze Aug 23–27 for an internal release; please avoid scheduling critical cutovers that week.

Can we schedule the 30-min sync on Tue Jul 21 at 10:00 PT? Evan (our integration lead) will join and can walk the API test vectors he expects. Also can you add an action column to the milestone ledger that lists the acceptance criteria per milestone?

—Caroline
Director, Platform Engineering | Helix AI

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Lee <caroline.lee@helixai.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@helixai.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared delivery playbook & milestone ledger — proposed sprint calendar

Appreciate the quick reply, Caroline — Tue Jul 21, 10:00 PT works on our side. I updated the milestone ledger and included a new "Acceptance / Action" column in the attached CSV (milestone-ledger.csv). Summary of internal owners for clarity: 

- Provisioning & network allowlist: Helix ops (point: Evan) / Redwood provisioning (owner: marissa_cole)
- API integration & test vectors: Helix engineering (Evan) / Redwood integration support (owner: neha_kapoor)
- Load and latency validation: Redwood SRE (owner: marissa_cole) with Helix test harness
- Canary orchestration & monitoring hooks: Redwood CS + SRE (owner: neha_kapoor)
- Final acceptance & SLA handoff: Helix product ops + Redwood CS (joint)

I also noted the blackout Aug 23–27 and moved the canary window earlier (proposed Aug 16–29 as a two-week canary, aligning buffer prior). If procurement needs the SOW signed before Aug 2, we’ll prioritize the DocuSign routing this week.

Next steps for the Tuesday sync:
- Caroline/Evan: confirm the test vector spec and canary targets
- Procurement: confirm billing contact and signature party (procurement@helixai.com)
- Neha/Marissa: prepare short runbook (15–20 slides) covering owner contacts, rollback plans, and monitoring thresholds

I’ll bring the updated CSV to the meeting and we can lock dates live.

Thanks,
Rishi

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Caroline Lee <caroline.lee@helixai.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@helixai.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Helix delivery owners + prep for Tue sync (quick actions)

Team — looping you in to confirm owners and immediate prep items for Tuesday 10:00 PT. Please reply inline with availability and any gaps.

Quick asks: 
- Neha: lead CS checklist + monitoring SLAs, prepare the short runbook slides (1 slide per milestone).
- Marissa: prepare provisioning checklist, SRE runbook bullets, and the rollback plan. Marissa — I assigned you as owner for provisioning and load validation in the ledger.
- Both: review the milestone-ledger.csv and add estimated effort (hrs) in the effort column before Tue. I put placeholder dates; you can adjust.

Caroline/Evan: I’ll keep you in the loop but team will not make final changes without you in the sync.

Thanks — Rishi

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Caroline Lee <caroline.lee@helixai.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@helixai.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Helix delivery owners + prep for Tue sync (quick actions)

Acknowledged — I’ll take the monitoring/CS runbook and draft the thresholds. Will add estimated effort to the ledger by EOD Mon Jul 20.

—Neha
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Caroline Lee <caroline.lee@helixai.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@helixai.com>, procurement@helixai.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Helix delivery owners + prep for Tue sync (quick actions)

On it — I added provisioning steps and a short rollback checklist to the playbook (see attached SOW-draft-Helix-RW-v1.pdf for baseline terms). For the canary: recommendation is to start with internal traffic (1–2% prod-equivalent) for week 1 and expand to 10–15% in week 2; I’ll include the verification scripts and smoke tests.

I’ll have the runbook slides and an updated ledger with effort numbers by Monday EOD. If procurement confirms DocuSign routing today we can still hit the Aug 2 procurement milestone.

-Marissa
Implementation PM | Redwood Inference
